class_id: a container is unwrapped to one member, and the other members are silently dropped
feature: any download that arrives as an archive or bundle (zip, multi-attachment mail, multi-file API response) where the reader picks ONE member to keep
symptom: a bundle is treated as a wrapper around one file, so the unwrap step chooses a member (by name, else the largest) and discards the rest without a trace. When the bundle actually carries several distinct documents, every member except the chosen one is lost, and anything the lost members would have changed never happens. Nothing fails: the chosen member is valid, the store has a row, and the missing documents are absent rows, which no per-row check can see. Universal shape: an unwrap step that returns one thing from a container of N answers a narrower question (which member is the one we wanted?) than the one the data poses (what did the container hold?).
first_seen: 2026-09-24, IPODhan F-154: all 41 distinct NSE RHP/DRHP/PROSPECTUS zips on staging hold 2 or more PDFs; 5 hold a corrigendum or price-band notice; selectZipMemberForType keeps the RHP and drops them, and 4 of those 5 IPOs (hy-tech-engineers-ltd, abh-healthcare-ltd, madhur-knit-crafts-ltd, rays-of-belief-ltd) have no CORRIGENDUM/PRICE_BAND_AD document at all, so OD-30 corrigendum precedence cannot fire for them.
